records.text: Pam Bondi disbanded the Foreign Influence Task Force on her first day, eliminating the DOJ office responsible for enforcing FARA.
records.speaker: Ian Carroll

appearances.snippet: Pam Bondi, on her first day, disbands the Foreign Influence Task Force, the very DOJ office responsible for enforcing FARA, the Foreign Agents Registration Act.

verification.notes: Attorney General Bondi’s February 5, 2025 memorandum did disband the Foreign Influence Task Force. But it did not eliminate the FARA Unit: the same memo directed the Counterintelligence and Export Control Section, including the FARA Unit, to focus on civil enforcement, regulatory initiatives, and public guidance. The statement is correct on disbandment but wrong that the DOJ office responsible for FARA was eliminated.

links.title: Bondi Disbands Foreign Influence Task Force

records.text: The Foreign Influence Task Force shall be disbanded, and FARA criminal charges shall be limited to conduct similar to traditional espionage by foreign government actors.
records.speaker: Pam Bondi

appearances.snippet: To free resources to address more pressing priorities, excuse me, and end risks of further weaponization and abuses of prosecutorial discretion, the Foreign Influence Task Force shall be disbanded. Recourse to criminal charges under the Foreign Agents Registration Act and 18 code 951 shall be limited to instances of alleged conduct similar to more traditional espionage by foreign government actors.

verification.notes: This closely tracks the February 5, 2025 DOJ memorandum, which says the Foreign Influence Task Force shall be disbanded and FARA or section 951 criminal charges limited to alleged conduct similar to traditional espionage by foreign government actors.
